items: 【Storage Headboard with Fast-Charging】The headboard is equipped with a built-in fast-charging socket, including 2 AC Outlets, a USB port and a type-C port, allowing you to charge various electronic devices within easy reach. 2-Tier storage shelf on the headboard can provide more storage space, making it convenient for you to place commonly used items such as magazines, phones, alarm clocks, etc.

【RGB LED Light Bed Frame】This bed frame is equipped with RGB LED light belt, you can use the equipped remote control or mobile APP to set the LED color, brightness, mode, timing function, etc., to meet the needs of different styles and different scenes, make your home life more colorful. The LED function comes with detailed instructions, and you can follow the instructions to complete the corresponding settings.

【4 Sliding Storage Drawers】 4 sliding drawers of this bed frame are designed to make this bed more practical. These drawers not only can store seasonal clothes and other belongings. The drawer also comes with screw clips, which you can easily secure drawers to the bottom of the bed to prevent the drawer from slipping out.

【Noise-Free Design】In order to eliminate the squeak and ensure your sleep quality, we specially added a mute sponge bar to the middle beam to avoid the friction between the metal components. When you are sleeping or active in this bed, you are no longer disturbed by noise.

【Sturdy Metal Structure】 The bed frame adopts an all-metal support system, which is sturdy. We have replaced ordinary wooden slats with 11 metal rods, greatly improving load-bearing capacity, 9 metal bed legs increase the stability of the bed frame at the same time, so it can easily support up to 800lbs. This structure is designed to give you a great sense of security and a restful sleep.

【Friendly Reminder】 The visual size of the product in the photo may vary due to factors such as shooting angle and comparison with reference objects. Please carefully check the product dimension diagram before shopping to confirm the actual size of the product. Material information is also detailed on the product page. Thank you for your understanding.
